scope: Isolated protobuf decoder comparison before record transfer hooks. Eager indexing is an exploratory candidate; lazy indexing is the final implementation.

eager_experiment.quiet_note: All task-created Linux builds and Windows/macOS VM build/test children had stopped before this run; collaborating agents held restarts until completion. The pre-existing Mac PerfPowerServices process and normal desktop activity remained. Benchmark children alone were pinned to logical CPU 9 (SMT sibling 21). Current governor powersave, energy preference balance_performance, scaling maximum 3289474 kHz; no system settings or unrelated affinities changed. Before and after used exactly matching frozen consumer sources, same GCC version and production flags, independently validated identical wire fixtures, and isolated SDK prefixes. Five alternating fresh-process pairs per row; counts based on the earlier baseline matrix target roughly 0.5 CPU seconds before optimization, with 64 warmup operations. Sampling is separate from headline paired timings.
